items.text: Classic unified chrome (C10) — on Classic layout, the configuration header, save row, and tab bar now fuse into one connected card with shared border, radius, and shadow — matching the Modern/Glass chrome card introduced in v2026.07.01.

Keyboard tab list shell (A7) — Config → Keyboard uses the shared .config-tab-surface pattern: filter toolbar inside the surface, shortcut sections as divided rows (no nested floating cards), consistent with Pages, Categories, Tags, Finders, and Collections.

Bookmarks tab shell (B2/B4) — the Bookmarks workspace (Context panel, filters, split-view list) sits inside one .bookmarks-tab-surface card. Search uses the shared config-filter-field styling so Bookmarks visually matches other list tabs.

Stats tab surface (B9) — filter toolbar (table search, Refresh, Export CSV), chip navigation, sidebar index, and stats blocks fuse into one .stats-tab-surface card with divided rows instead of separate stacked cards.
Backups tab surface (B9) — ZIP backup, settings export/import, and CSV sections appear as divided rows inside one .backups-tab-surface card (danger section keeps its inset accent stripe).

Health badge count pill — dashboard and config header health links show a compact count-only pill (e.g. 3 or 99+) with theme accent colours for broken vs warning counts. Screen readers still get a full aria-label; the old broken text label is removed from the visible badge.

Inline bookmark editor — long-press inline edit no longer traps the form behind dashboard inert. Background dimming uses opacity only so fields stay interactive in all browsers; save and click-outside handling is hardened.

Modern & Glass bookmark row highlight — keyboard-selected and focused bookmarks again use a full-row accent gradient (matching Classic) instead of a subtle border-only outline. Applies to all layout presets (terminal, cards, masonry, list, widgets), status rows, and softened selection after mouse hover.

Cross-browser promo sync — dismissed Got it promos, What's new last-seen release, and rotating-tips timing now persist in settings.json under discoverabilityState. Open the dashboard on another browser or device and your progress follows (legacy localStorage keys migrate automatically on first load).

Promo reliability — dashboard discoverability promos are restored after a regression; auto-show for paste URL, preview-cards, and layout-version nudges stays off (reset individually from Tours & onboarding if you want them back).
Config → Help (EN / NL / DE / FR) — What's new recap and General help document fused Stats/Backups/Keyboard/Bookmarks surfaces, Classic chrome parity, health count badge, and discoverability sync.
README, MANUAL, CHANGELOG — release notes for v2026.07.01.1; Playwright config suite extended for Keyboard list shell, Bookmarks surface, and Stats/Backups surfaces.
